name: KenyonExpress - Payments
description: Money-path health: Cardcom transport and webhooks, checkout reads, payment_events writes, refunds, settlements and reconciliation. Every panel reads the structured log stream.

query.apl: ['{{dataset}}'] | where level == 'error' and (event startswith 'cardcom.' or event startswith 'payment' or event startswith 'checkout.' or event startswith 'refund.' or event startswith 'settlement.' or event startswith 'reconcile.') | summarize errors = count()

['{{dataset}}'] | where level == 'error' and (event startswith 'cardcom.' or event startswith 'payment' or event startswith 'checkout.' or event startswith 'refund.' or event startswith 'settlement.' or event startswith 'reconcile.') | summarize count() by bin_auto(_time), event
['{{dataset}}'] | where event startswith 'payment_events.' | summarize count() by bin_auto(_time), event

['{{dataset}}'] | where level == 'error' and (event startswith 'cardcom.' or event startswith 'payment' or event startswith 'checkout.' or event startswith 'refund.' or event startswith 'settlement.' or event startswith 'reconcile.') | project _time, event, route, request_id | sort by _time desc | limit 50
